import java.util.*;

class Pos {
    int row, col;
    Pos(int row, int col) { this.row = row; this.col = col; }
}

public class Main {
    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 0, 1};
    static int[] dc = {0, -1, 1, 0};
    static int N, T;
    static char[][] B = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B1 = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] B2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] D1 = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] D2 = new int[12][12];
    static final int INF = 98765432;

    static void bfs1(Pos src) {
        for (int[] row : D1) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        D1[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                Pos nxt = new Pos(cur.row + dr[k], cur.col + dc[k]);
                if (B[nxt.row][nxt.col] != '.') continue;
                if (D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] < 0) {
                    D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] = D1[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(Pos src) {
        for (int[] row : D2) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        D2[src.row][src.col] = 0;
        Queue<Pos> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(src);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pos cur = q.poll();
            if (D1[cur.row][cur.col] >= 0 &&
                D2[cur.row][cur.col] >= D1[cur.row][cur.col])
                continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                Pos nxt = new Pos(cur.row + dr[k], cur.col + dc[k]);
                if (B[nxt.row][nxt.col] != '.') continue;
                if (D2[nxt.row][nxt.col] < 0) {
                    if (D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] >= 0 &&
                        D1[nxt.row][nxt.col] < D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1)
                        continue;
                    D2[nxt.row][nxt.col] = D2[cur.row][cur.col] + 1;
                    q.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int N;
        int[][] cap;
        int[][] flow;
        int[] bfs_par, bfs_D;

        MaxFlow(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            cap = new int[N][N];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int _cap) {
            cap[u][v] += _cap;
        }

        int augmentingPathBFS(int src, int dst, List<Integer> path, int mincap) {
            bfs_par = new int[N];
            bfs_D = new int[N];
            Arrays.fill(bfs_par, -1);
            Arrays.fill(bfs_D, -1);
            bfs_D[src] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int cur = q.poll();
                if (cur == dst) {
                    int cfp = INF;
                    path.clear();
                    // Determine path length
                    int len = bfs_D[dst];
                    // We'll reconstruct path backwards
                    int[] tempPath = new int[len+1];
                    tempPath[len] = dst;
                    int curv = dst;
                    for (int k = len-1; k >= 0 && bfs_par[curv] >= 0; k--) {
                        int prev = bfs_par[curv];
                        cfp = Math.min(cfp, cap[prev][curv] - flow[prev][curv]);
                        curv = prev;
                        tempPath[k] = prev;
                    }
                    for (int i = 0; i <= len; i++) path.add(tempPath[i]);
                    return cfp;
                }
                for (int v = 0; v < N; v++) {
                    if (bfs_D[v] < 0 && cap[cur][v] - flow[cur][v] > mincap) {
                        bfs_D[v] = bfs_D[cur] + 1;
                        bfs_par[v] = cur;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            path.clear();
            return 0;
        }

        int dinic(int s, int t) {
            N = cap.length;
            flow = new int[N][N];
            List<Integer> path = new ArrayList<>();
            int res = 0;
            while (true) {
                int cfp = augmentingPathBFS(s, t, path, 0);
                if (path.isEmpty()) break;
                // Try finding more paths from any w adjacent to sink
                for (int w = 0; w < N; w++) {
                    if (bfs_D[w] >= 0 && cap[w][t] - flow[w][t] > 0) {
                        int cfp2 = cap[w][t] - flow[w][t];
                        int curv = w, prev = bfs_par[w];
                        while (prev >= 0) {
                            cfp2 = Math.min(cfp2, cap[prev][curv] - flow[prev][curv]);
                            curv = prev;
                            prev = bfs_par[prev];
                        }
                        flow[w][t] += cfp2;
                        flow[t][w] = -flow[w][t];
                        curv = w;
                        prev = bfs_par[w];
                        while (prev >= 0) {
                            flow[prev][curv] += cfp2;
                            flow[curv][prev] = -flow[prev][curv];
                            curv = prev;
                            prev = bfs_par[prev];
                        }
                        res += cfp2;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        // Initialize borders
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(B1[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(B2[i], '#');
            Arrays.fill(B[i], '#');
        }

        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine().trim();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                B1[r][c] = line.charAt(c-1);
            }
            B1[r][N+1] = '#';
        }

        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine().trim();
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                B2[r][c] = line.charAt(c-1);
            }
            B2[r][N+1] = '#';
        }

        List<Pos> scientists = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Pos> capsules = new ArrayList<>();
        Pos z = null;

        for (int r = 1; r <= N; r++) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= N; c++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(B1[r][c])) {
                    if (B1[r][c] > '0')
                        scientists.add(new Pos(r, c));
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                } else if (B1[r][c] == 'Z') {
                    z = new Pos(r, c);
                    B[r][c] = '.';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(B2[r][c]) && B2[r][c] > '0')
                    capsules.add(new Pos(r, c));
            }
        }

        bfs1(z);

        int SRC = 0;
        int SINK = scientists.size() + capsules.size() + 1;
        MaxFlow mf = new MaxFlow(SINK + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); i++) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            mf.addEdge(SRC, i+1, B1[s.row][s.col] - '0');
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); j++) {
            Pos c = capsules.get(j);
            mf.addEdge(scientists.size() + j + 1, SINK, B2[c.row][c.col] - '0');
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < scientists.size(); i++) {
            Pos s = scientists.get(i);
            bfs2(s);
            for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); j++) {
                Pos c = capsules.get(j);
                if (D2[c.row][c.col] >= 0 && D2[c.row][c.col] <= T)
                    mf.addEdge(i+1, scientists.size() + j + 1, INF);
            }
        }

        int res = mf.dinic(SRC, SINK);
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
